verdict.rationale: Mintlify offers multiple official MCP servers documented and runtime-verified: a hosted search MCP for docs sites, a universal Index MCP for read-only research, and an admin/write MCP with proper OAuth gating, all confirmed via live handshakes. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on validation of MCP client compatibility across agents like Claude/Cursor beyond Mintlify's own docs and probes.
